correctness.rationale: The scalar normal equation gives t=1/2-(h·D+epsilon/2)/(||D||^2+epsilon). The half-sum h and difference D are independent Gaussians by zero cross-covariance; D has covariance 2 sigma^2 I and the strictly positive displayed density at zero. At zero ridge the only unbounded-in-D term is -Delta (h·omega)/r, r=||D||. Its upper bound gives the radial integral r^(d-1-q), while a compact positive-probability h set and a spherical cap (a sign in d=1) give a uniform nonzero lower bound on |h·omega| and exclude cancellation by the bounded remainder. This proves both directions including the critical divergence. For epsilon>0 the singular coefficient Q is bounded by ||h||/(2 sqrt(epsilon)); the remaining vector is uniformly bounded in L^2 as epsilon decreases. In E Q^2, replacing p_D(r omega) by p_D(0) locally costs at most O(log(1/epsilon)) in d=1 and O(1) in d=2; the integral away from zero is bounded. The full-line d=1 integral is pi/(2 sqrt(epsilon)); in d=2 the angular average integral equals pi C_h and the radial integral is (1/2)log(1/epsilon)+O(1). Cauchy–Schwarz makes the cross term lower order. For d>=3, ||h||^2/||D||^2 is integrable and gives L^2 dominated convergence. These are analytic checks; the bundled quadrature was inspected, not replayed, and is not needed for the theorem.
residual_risks: Fixed distinct noiselessly specified sites, positive isotropic Gaussian variance, unit mixing and a penalty on the single coefficient t are essential to the stated model. Nothing is inferred for adapted snapshots or repeated iterations.

value.rationale: The dimension transition determines when mean square is even a valid performance measure for the unsafeguarded fixed-input update. The exact regularization cost, especially the critical logarithmic term with an explicit coefficient, gives information not available from positive-ridge finiteness or an upper bound on the regularized inverse. This is a motivated model of a single mixing step, not a convergence guarantee.
residual_risks: No extension to adaptive penalties or multiple updates is claimed.
